early_braking_confidence.symptom: Brake application begins significantly before the optimal braking point
early_braking_confidence.diagnosis: Driver lacks confidence in braking ability or track knowledge, resulting in premature brake application and unnecessary speed loss on approach

late_braking_aggressive.symptom: Brake application begins past the optimal braking point, causing excessive corner-entry speed
late_braking_aggressive.diagnosis: Driver over-commits to late braking, arriving too fast and compromising corner entry geometry and exit speed

insufficient_brake_pressure.symptom: Peak braking deceleration well below vehicle capability
insufficient_brake_pressure.diagnosis: Driver does not apply enough initial brake pressure, under-utilizing available grip and extending braking distance

no_trail_braking.symptom: Brake fully released before turn-in with no overlap between braking and steering
no_trail_braking.diagnosis: Driver separates braking and turning completely, missing the weight transfer benefit that loads the front tyres for better turn-in grip

abrupt_brake_release.symptom: Brake pressure drops sharply rather than being trailed off progressively
abrupt_brake_release.diagnosis: Driver snaps off the brakes instead of progressively releasing, causing sudden weight transfer rearward and destabilizing the car at turn-in

inconsistent_brake_point.symptom: Braking point varies significantly across laps for the same corner
inconsistent_brake_point.diagnosis: Driver has not anchored a repeatable reference point, leading to lap-to-lap inconsistency in corner entry

braking_while_turning.symptom: Heavy braking continues deep into the corner with high steering angle applied
braking_while_turning.diagnosis: Driver carries excessive brake pressure past the trail-brake zone into the cornering phase, exceeding the traction circle and risking lockup or understeer

early_apex.symptom: Vehicle reaches the geometric inside of the corner before the ideal apex point
early_apex.diagnosis: Driver turns in too early, running out of road on exit and having to lift or tighten the line, losing exit speed

late_apex_excessive.symptom: Vehicle reaches the inside of the corner well past the geometric apex
late_apex_excessive.diagnosis: Driver over-delays turn-in, sacrificing mid-corner speed in pursuit of exit speed beyond the point of diminishing returns

mid_corner_speed_loss.symptom: Significant speed drop at apex compared to theoretical minimum speed
mid_corner_speed_loss.diagnosis: Driver carries too little speed through the corner apex, either from over-slowing on entry or mid-corner hesitation

excess_steering_angle.symptom: Steering angle exceeds the optimal slip angle, indicating understeer or over-rotation
excess_steering_angle.diagnosis: Driver uses more steering input than necessary, scrubbing speed through excessive front tyre slip

corner_entry_too_fast.symptom: Entry speed exceeds the corner's grip envelope, requiring mid-corner correction
corner_entry_too_fast.diagnosis: Driver arrives too fast into the corner, exceeding available grip and having to lift, scrub speed, or run wide

tightening_radius.symptom: Corner radius decreases through the turn as driver runs out of road
tightening_radius.diagnosis: Driver's line progressively tightens, indicating an early turn-in or too much entry speed, requiring increasing steering lock and speed reduction

mid_corner_correction.symptom: Sudden steering input change or throttle adjustment mid-corner
mid_corner_correction.diagnosis: Driver makes a reactive correction mid-corner due to line error, speed misjudgement, or loss of confidence in grip level

late_throttle_application.symptom: Throttle application begins well after the apex, leaving exit speed on the table
late_throttle_application.diagnosis: Driver waits too long after the apex to get on throttle, missing the optimal acceleration window for the exit straight

hesitant_throttle.symptom: Throttle application is gradual and tentative rather than progressively decisive
hesitant_throttle.diagnosis: Driver applies throttle too cautiously on exit, under-utilizing available rear grip and losing acceleration time

mid_corner_lift.symptom: Throttle drops significantly between apex and exit while still cornering
mid_corner_lift.diagnosis: Driver lifts off throttle mid-corner, shifting weight forward and reducing rear grip, potentially causing oversteer or losing momentum

poor_exit_speed.symptom: Exit speed significantly below theoretical optimum for the corner
poor_exit_speed.diagnosis: Driver leaves too much speed on the table at corner exit, which cascades as time loss down the following straight

track_out_not_used.symptom: Vehicle does not use the full track width on corner exit
track_out_not_used.diagnosis: Driver stays away from the exit kerb, using a tighter exit line than necessary and limiting the radius available for acceleration

lap_time_variation.symptom: Lap times vary more than expected between clean laps
lap_time_variation.diagnosis: Driver's lap-to-lap pace is inconsistent, suggesting concentration lapses or inconsistent technique application

corner_speed_variation.symptom: Apex or exit speed varies significantly across laps for the same corner
corner_speed_variation.diagnosis: Driver executes the same corner differently each lap, indicating technique has not been consolidated into muscle memory

late_session_degradation.symptom: Lap times increase in the final third of the session
late_session_degradation.diagnosis: Driver's performance drops as the session progresses, suggesting physical or mental fatigue affecting concentration and reaction time

sector_imbalance.symptom: One sector consistently weaker relative to theoretical compared to other sectors
sector_imbalance.diagnosis: Driver has a sector-specific weakness, often due to unfamiliarity with a particular corner type or sequence in that section

tyre_abuse.symptom: Tyre grip degrades faster than expected across a session or stint
tyre_abuse.diagnosis: Driver's driving style generates excessive heat or wear in the tyres through aggressive inputs, reducing grip available in later laps

fuel_weight_unadjusted.symptom: Driving style does not adapt as fuel load decreases
fuel_weight_unadjusted.diagnosis: Driver does not adjust braking points and corner speeds as the car gets lighter with fuel burn, leaving time on the table in later stints

kerb_avoidance.symptom: Driver avoids kerbs that are safe to use for wider cornering line
kerb_avoidance.diagnosis: Driver stays away from kerbs, using a tighter line than necessary and limiting the effective track width available for faster cornering
